note: MM3 (DOS) monster id -> name, id = index into Mon*.dat tables. Derived by cross-referencing decoded (HP, AC, Speed, NumAttacks) 4-field fingerprints per id against the community bestiary at https://shrines.rpgclassics.com/pc/mm3/monsters.shtml (89 monsters, alphabetical). 61/90 ids matched a unique monster with all 4 fields exact and zero ambiguity (no name matched more than one id, no id matched more than one name). The remaining 29 ids are NOT in this table -- do not guess: 8 have a plausible 3-of-4-field near match (worth a follow-up, possibly a stat-table revision between game versions) and 21 have no candidate at all (the shrine page lists only 89 names against 90 internal ids). See docs/mm3/TODO.md `mm3-mon-stats`.
